prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D illustration for the story intro of an underground survival game, wide 16:9 composition. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no text.
Use case: style-transfer. Edit reference scene 3 into EXTREMELY SIMPLE FLAT GRAPHIC INDIE STORY ART. Preserve the scene composition and narrative, reduce every element to rounded or angular filled shapes with thick dark-brown outlines. Exactly seven broad colour families, no rendered texture. REMOVE 95 percent of small details: no rock cracks, no fabric weave, no realistic mountain rendering, no realistic fur, no realistic facial anatomy. Mountains and cave walls are a few smooth broad colour slabs. Characters are short round sturdy 2.5-head-tall little people with dot eyes and mitten hands, scalloped fur with at most 3 inner tufts. Broad completely plain colour areas as in Hilda animation. Depth only by overlapping flat planes, never shading. No gradients. Keep bottom fifth calm. Keep full 16:9 frame, no borders.
source_prompt:
undefined
Use case: illustration-story. Full story scene 3, wide 1920x1080 composition, no borders. The walk: a long line of survivors crossing deep snow at dusk, small and dark against a huge blue landscape, each carrying a lantern or a clay pot of embers, the lights making a dotted line. Epic quiet wide landscape, distant pale blue mountains and dark desaturated blue hills. Tiny stout bundled figures follow a winding path across middle ground, several closer figures at right foreground. Lantern fire is flat orange and cream shapes, no glow. Bottom fifth calm snow. Flat graphic shapes, strong silhouettes, depth from layered planes; distant planes lighter and bluer, never blurred. Simple clean ink with big plain fills; restrained paper grain only within fills.
rejected: First full-scene generation was too detailed; edited to broad flat graphic shapes.
